map.口令 + salt（16字节）+ 迭代 100000 + SHA256 → 固定: Passphrase + salt (16 bytes) + 100000 iterations + SHA256 -> a fixed-length key; more iterations resist brute force better. ...
map.从口令派生定长密钥，支持 SHA-1 / SHA-256 / SHA-384 /: Derive a fixed-length key from a passphrase, supporting SHA-1 / SHA-256 / SHA-384 / SHA-512
map.可指定盐值、迭代次数与输出长度，参数影响抗爆破强度: You can specify the salt, iteration count and output length, which affect brute-force resistance
map.输出可选十六进制、Base64 或二进制字符串: Output can be hexadecimal, Base64 or a binary string
map.用于复算与验证新旧实现的派生结果是否一致: Used to recompute and check whether the derived results of the old and new implementations agree
map.从口令派生加密密钥，带盐与迭代次数。: Derive an encryption key from a passphrase, with a salt and an iteration count.
map.给已有系统做口令哈希迁移：按约定的盐、迭代次数与输出长度复算，确认与新实现结果一: Migrate password hashes in an existing system: recompute with the agreed salt, iteration count and output length, confirm it matches the new implementation, then switch over.
map.输入要派生的口令（不要填明文密码以外的敏感信息）: Enter the passphrase to derive (do not put anything sensitive in it other than the plain passphrase)
map.填盐值：每个用户应各不相同，且长度不低于 16 字节: Enter the salt: it should differ for every user and be at least 16 bytes
map.设迭代次数：口令哈希场景建议不低于 600000 次（OWASP 量级），密钥派: Set the iteration count: for password hashing at least 600000 is recommended (OWASP order of magnitude); key derivation can be lower but not below 10000
map.选择输出长度（字节）与输出格式: Choose the output length in bytes and the output format
map.迁移旧系统时，用旧参数复算一遍并与库里的值比对，一致再切换新参数: When migrating a legacy system, recompute once with the old parameters and compare against the stored value, switching only when they agree
map.同时每个口令必须用独立随机盐，并把算法参数与密文一起存储以便将来升级: At the same time each passphrase needs its own random salt, and the algorithm parameters must be stored alongside the ciphertext so the scheme can be upgraded later
map.PBKDF2 与 bcrypt 怎么选？: How do I choose between PBKDF2 and bcrypt?
map.存储口令二者皆可，PBKDF2 更通用，bcrypt 实现更简单安全。: Either works for storing passphrases; PBKDF2 is more general while bcrypt is simpler and equally secure to implement.
map.原则是「在可接受延迟内取最大值」：常取使单次计算耗时约 100–250 毫秒的数: The principle is "take the largest value within acceptable delay": typically the value that makes one computation take about 100-250 ms, raised year by year as hardware improves. OWASP's reference figure is at least 600,000 iterations for PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 (adjusted over time). At the same time each passphrase needs its own random salt, and the algorithm parameters must be stored alongside the ciphertext so the scheme can be upgraded later.
